newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Mitac halves '96 profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Mitac halves '96 profit forecast.

text.p: Taiwan's Mitac International Corp on Friday halved its 1996 pretax profit forecast to T$161 million and trimmed its full-year sales forecast to T$13 billion from T$17.5 billion, citing tougher computer market conditions.
The original profit target had been T$328 million.
Mitac, in a brief statement, attributed the adjustments to "changes in our basic assumptions" about sales in the computer marketplace.
Mitac is one of Taiwan's leading personal computer makers, specialising in laptop and portable models.
Mitac's move followed a late August announcement by Taiwan computer giant Acer Inc also halving its 1996 profit forecast to T$3 billion from T$6 billion.
Acer trimmed its 1996 sales forecast to T$68.52 billion from T$80 billion, citing a slowdown in the semiconductor and personal computer industry.
